title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: Adding polynomial features to a model can affect both bias and variance. Consider how increasing the complexity of the model might impact these two aspects.

title: Effect of Polynomial Features
text: Adding degree $$3$$ polynomial features increases the complexity of the model. Think about how this affects the model's ability to fit the training data and generalize to new data.

title: Bias in Complex Models
text: A more complex model, such as one with polynomial features, tends to have lower bias because it can fit the training data more closely. However, consider the trade-off with variance.

title: Variance in Complex Models
text: While a complex model can fit the training data well, it may not generalize well to new data, leading to higher variance. This is the trade-off between bias and variance.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given the trade-off between bias and variance, does adding degree $$3$$ polynomial features increase bias?
